title: watch on an ended, merged run: tick count, CI and ci-phase disagree with the facts
description: Screenshots 2026-10-06 of `ticfac watch hn6` after hn6 merged (PR #219, main CI green at ce124e8c): the header says '80/80 ticks' while the table says '✓ 83 closed'; the CI line says 'CI: no PR yet' although the PR merged and CI was green; the phase strip shows '◐ ci' (in progress) next to '✓ merge'. The ended-run dashboard must show one consistent tick count (and say what the difference is, e.g. role/duplicate ticks), the PR as merged with its CI verdict, and ci as done when land_verified. Colour accents and the 80x24 fit are now right.
acceptance_criteria: Frame tests on an ended+merged fixture run: counts agree, CI line names the merged PR and green CI, ci phase is done. make gate passes.
